objective: Govern flat-tier seats end to end across pricing, billing, tenant membership, roles, invitations, access, audit and lifecycle.
invariants: I01 Stripe bills one flat-tier package unit and does not determine member identity.
I02 Effective seat capacity is server-derived from the versioned plan policy.
I03 Professional permits at most three active or reserved seats.
I04 Team permits at most fifteen active or reserved seats.
I05 The controlled trial permits at most two active or reserved seats.
I06 A pending unexpired invitation reserves exactly one seat.
I07 Invitation acceptance converts the existing reservation and never consumes a second seat.
I08 Invitation expiry, revocation or delivery failure releases the reservation.
I09 Membership revocation releases the active seat and invalidates active roles.
I10 Two concurrent allocations at the last available seat cannot both succeed.
I11 Downgrade is denied while occupied seats exceed target capacity.
I12 The last active organisation owner cannot be revoked or demoted.
I13 Tenant and membership authority are resolved server-side, never from browser tenant input.
I14 Missing membership or entitlement denies product access.
I15 READ_ONLY permits reads and denies writes.
I16 SUSPENDED and CANCELLED deny product access.
I17 The application role cannot directly mutate seat, membership, role or audit tables.
I18 RLS is enabled and forced on every tenant-scoped governance table.
I19 Invitation tokens are single-use; only digests are persisted.
I20 Production invitation delivery fails closed without an approved provider.
I21 Test invitation tokens are exposed only inside the isolated test runtime.
I22 Membership and invitation audit events are append-only.
I23 Billing, seat entitlement, membership and technical quota remain distinct authorities.
I24 A plan label in the UI is not proof that capacity was persisted.
I25 Models and workers cannot create memberships, invite users or grant roles.
I26 Role changes and revocations require active owner or admin authority.
I27 Cross-tenant membership, invitation and allocation access returns no rows.
I28 Idempotent operation identifiers cannot reserve duplicate seats.
I29 Plan suspension revokes pending invitations and releases reserved seats.
I30 Commercial activation requires independent human authority.
truth_boundaries: seat range in copy != persisted seat capacity
seat available != source rights or technical quota
